rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something that was not anticipated, especially before a noun.

example.english: This power outage was an unforeseen incident.
example.traditional: 今次停電係意料之外嘅事故。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ting4 din6 hai6 ji3 liu6 zi1 ngoi6 ge3 si6 gu3

rows.note: Choose this colloquial form when stressing that nobody could have guessed or expected what happened.

example.english: It was truly unforeseen that they would suddenly resign.
example.traditional: 真係估唔到佢會突然辭職。
example.jyutping: zan1 hai6 gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 wui5 dat6 jin4 ci4 zik1
